vision-image-attach.Label: Image attach now does real vision/OCR, not filename-as-text
vision-image-attach.body:
ROOT CAUSE of 'can't extract data from uploaded image': FileInput.jsx (used by SearchBar.jsx paperclip) read a picked file but NEVER sent its bytes anywhere — the isImage branch just stuffed the FILENAME into the search query text box (e.g. 'image search: 9k=.jpg') and auto-submitted a garbage text search. The actual pixels were discarded. Separately verified the Pics/Vids CONTENT-CATEGORY TABS were NOT broken — live-tested the real backend (/api/search cat=images/videos returns real Brave Images + YouTube results) AND a full Playwright click-through of the tabs; both work. So 'video or image search' complaint = the SAME attach-flow bug, not the tabs.

FIX (new capability, not just a patch): SearchBar's isImage branch now reads the file via FileReader.readAsDataURL, stashes {dataUrl,name} in sessionStorage under 'truegle_pending_image', and navigates to /chat?hasImage=1(&q=...). TruegleChat.jsx picks it up in a single merged mount effect (avoids a state-timing race between two separate effects), shows an attach chip (remove button) above the input, echoes the image in the user's own bubble, and threads it into aiAPI.chat as . Backend: routes/ai.js POST /chat accepts  (data: URL, 8MB cap), UnifiedAIService.chat builds an OpenAI/Groq-vision-shaped multimodal content array ([{type:'text'},{type:'image_url'}]) and forces provider=['groq'] + model=config.ai.groq.visionModel ('qwen/qwen3.6-27b', GROQ_VISION_MODEL env override) for image turns only — skips normal DB-driven provider order since only Groq is vision-wired. Image turns are excluded from the response cache (image+caption could collide with a different image sharing the same caption). Verified end-to-end via Playwright: real file upload -> /chat handoff -> attach chip -> send -> captured request body confirmed real base64 image data + typed question both reached /api/ai/chat -> response rendered -> user bubble shows the image. GroqService.js needed ZERO changes — it already spreads whatever messages array it's given, so multimodal content parts pass through untouched.

camera-attach-fix.Label: Camera Upload-Image/capture had the same discard-real-data bug as FileInput

The bug was in SearchBar.jsx's wiring: onImageCapture's imageDataUrl parameter was received but never used in the body, and onSearchSubmit ignored its argument too -- both just set localValue to generic placeholder text ('image search visual query') and submitted THAT. Fixed identically to the FileInput/paperclip fix: onSearchSubmit now takes the real imageDataUrl, stashes it in sessionStorage under truegle_pending_image, and navigates to /chat?hasImage=1(&q=...) for TruegleChat's existing pickup effect to consume. onImageCapture prop dropped entirely (redundant -- onSearchSubmit always fires right after it in CameraInput with the same data).

getplayable-host-check.body: Was host.endsWith('youtube.com'), which also matched attacker hosts like evilyoutube.com and would iframe them as a trusted embed. Now host === 'youtube.com' || host.endsWith('.youtube.com') (plus youtube-nocookie). Share links make this externally reachable — do not loosen it.

csp-player-hosts.Label: CSP frame-src must list every embed host
csp-player-hosts.body: public/_headers frame-src AND child-src had youtube.com/vimeo but NOT youtube-nocookie.com or w.soundcloud.com, so the mini-player's YouTube+SoundCloud embeds were blocked in production. Added youtube-nocookie.com, w.soundcloud.com, tiktok.com. Any new embed host needs BOTH directives updated or it silently fails to frame.

queue-persist.Label: Player queue persists in sessionStorage
queue-persist.body: PlayerContext saves {current,queue} to sessionStorage key truegle_player_queue. blob: sources (device files) are stripped on save — object URLs are document-scoped and would restore unplayable entries. Fixes 'navigating away erased my playlist'.

reels-discovery-limits.Label: Reels discovery: only YouTube Shorts is findable
reels-discovery-limits.body: TikTok/Instagram/Facebook Reels have NO free search API — discovery needs Meta/TikTok app review + audited dev app (same dead end as Reels oEmbed). YouTube Shorts IS discoverable. So the reels feed is fed two ways: discovered Shorts + community submissions (community_reels table, migration 017, /api/reels).

social-posting-blocked.Label: Cannot auto-post to FB/IG/TikTok/YouTube
social-posting-blocked.body: Posting on a user's behalf needs Meta/TikTok app review + business verification + audited app; /bin/bash budget. Also cannot watermark a third-party reel — we don't hold the video bytes (iframe embeds), ripping breaks ToS, and re-uploading under our mark misattributes the creator. Route that DOES work: navigator.share() native sheet (reaches IG/TikTok/YT via the user's own session) + public web intents (FB/X/Reddit/WhatsApp/Telegram/LinkedIn/Bluesky). Watermark goes on OUR surfaces + metadata on the /w link.

reels-autoscroll.Label: Reels auto-scroll is the default behaviour
reels-autoscroll.body: ShortsFeed auto-advances by default; preference persisted in localStorage truegle_reels_autoscroll. Auto/Repeat/Add-a-reel controls render OUTSIDE the items.length>0 guard — they were previously hidden entirely on an empty feed, which is why they looked missing. Dwell = clip duration clamped 8-90s; community-submitted reels have NO duration so they use the 30s default.

tube-bar-player.Label: Tube's collapsed player is a row UNDER the input, not inside it
tube-bar-player.body: SearchBar gained a belowSlot prop (rendered inside the pill wrapper, under the input). Tube uses it for the transport row and, when expanded, the whole player. The transport was first put in the input row via rightIcons — that left ~100px of usable input width on a phone and the placeholder wrapped one character per line. A -mt-3 tuck under the pill's rounded bottom makes bar+controls read as one surface. rightIcons now renders OUTSIDE the showMultiInput conditional so it survives showMultiInput={false}.

tube-bar-singleline.Label: Tube search bar is single-line horizontal
tube-bar-singleline.body: SearchBar gained singleLine prop: fixed height, white-space:nowrap, overflow-x:auto. Growing downward pushed the player further down on every wrapped line. The auto-resize effect must NOT read the "config" object (declared later in the component - causes "Cannot access config before initialization", which blanks the entire search bar); it clears the inline height and lets the style block pin it. Left icon + right controls get an opaque bg in singleLine so scrolled text hides behind them.

media-migration.Label: Migration 018 must be run in prod
media-migration.body: node apps/backend/scripts/run-migrations.js applies 018_community_media.sql. Until it runs, POST /api/media and GET /api/media/search 500 on a missing relation; the player still works because the community fetch fails soft to [].

channel-search-form.Label: Channel search only works as @handle
channel-search-form.body: Tested live: "Darkwaters 9" returns a film and a DND series; an OR group of spellings returns nothing useful (the provider does not honour OR grouping); @darkwaters9 returns the channel. So parsePlayerQuery normalises any channel to toHandle() — spaces/dots/dashes stripped, lowercased, leading @ — and sends site:youtube.com @handle. The Tube Channel chip pre-writes the box to that form and keeps spaces out while it is on.

youtube-api-wiring.Label: YOUTUBE_API_KEY wiring and its quota ceiling
youtube-api-wiring.body: Wired two ways in routes/creators.js: channels.list?forHandle for handle->channelId (1 unit, scrape kept as fallback) and GET /api/creators/search for real YouTube search (search.list = 100 units of a 10k/day free quota = ~100 searches/day for the WHOLE site). Because of that ceiling the frontend calls /creators/search only as a last resort, when web+community results yield nothing playable, and the backend caches each query for an hour. Quota exhaustion returns an empty list and degrades to whatever the web search had.

fullscreen-swipe.Label: Fullscreen swipe nav needs a transparent sheet
fullscreen-swipe.body: An iframe swallows touches, so gestures over the video are unreadable without an overlay. hooks/useSwipeNav.js mounts one ONLY in fullscreen (where our transport bar is already pinned, so losing the embed's controls costs nothing): swipe up = next, down = prev, tap = play/pause, arrows/space for desktop. touchAction pan-x or the browser scrolls the page instead.

groq-70b.Label: Default Groq model = 70B
groq-70b.body: GROQ_MODEL default bumped 8b-instant -> llama-3.3-70b-versatile (8B gave shallow summaries). Free-tier; multi-key rotation covers TPM.

transcripts-invidious.Label: Transcripts via Invidious
transcripts-invidious.body: Fetch captions from Invidious/Piped front-ends first (their IPs, not ours) to dodge YouTube rate-limit; direct scrape is fallback. Morty result-proxy can't scrape (strips <script>).

share-store.Label: Share store = Postgres
share-store.body: Shareable persistent threads use existing Postgres (shared_threads, migration 008), NOT Cloudflare KV — true $0/zero-ops.

multiselect-primary.Label: Multi-select design
multiselect-primary.body: Modes multi-select blends AI framing. On /search the PRIMARY mode stays single (drives sources/perspectives/OSINT routing); extra lenses only affect AI summary + follow-up chat, to avoid destabilizing the results pipeline.

osint-graph.Label: OSINT graph (GraphiPy)
osint-graph.body: OSINT investigations rendered as GraphiPy-model node/edge graph (OsintGraphService) with Gephi CSV + JSON export. User called it brilliant — keep.

no-jailbreak.Label: No jailbreaks
no-jailbreak.body: Won't build safety-bypasses. Real goal (fewer false denials on lawful requests) handled via refusal-failover + prompt-authorization + eventual self-hosted uncensored Nephesh.

purple-rename.Label: Purple = Perspectives
purple-rename.body: Purple MODE renamed Skeptical->Perspectives (labels/hook/landing). The skeptical bias LENS in PerspectiveSelector is a different concept, left as-is.

model-mandates.Label: Two absolute model mandates
model-mandates.body: BASE_IDENTITY + Modelfile carry: MANDATE A (no opinions of its own; help user form THEIR view from unbiased research; keep any verdict to itself) and MANDATE B (100% honesty/transparency; never deceive/mislead/manipulate/spin/omit/fabricate). No exceptions. PROMPT_VERSION 2026-07-12.2.

feedback-training.Label: Thumbs up/down feedback = training signal
feedback-training.body: ai_feedback table (migration 009). Thumbs-down REQUIRES a brief reason (DB CHECK + API guard). FeedbackButtons component on TruegleChat + AIChatOverlay; POST /api/ai/feedback stores vote+reason+answer+query+mode for later fine-tuning.

dev-env.Label: Secure dev env until launch
dev-env.body: Dev never touches prod. Use Neon 'dev' BRANCH (free, isolated, mirrors prod schema) OR local Postgres; fill .env once from .env.example. Soft launch F&F via Vercel/CF preview deploys pointed at the dev branch. Prod env vars set ONCE at launch. Full guide: DEV-SETUP.md. Official launch target ~2027.

brand-tagline.Label: Brand tagline + principles
brand-tagline.body: Tagline: 'TrueGLE. For the questions most search engines won't answer.' Always show principles: No bias / No tracking / No censorship. Footer: Truegle Co. (TM) 2026.

ui-redesign.Label: Final UI/UX redesign (chat-default)
ui-redesign.body: Full spec in docs/UI-REDESIGN-SPEC.md. Chat is DEFAULT (landing=chat entry, black pill); search is power-user. Uniform color-tinted search bar across all search pages; OSINT + rewards + extract are layout exceptions. Rename red mode Alternative->'Rabbit Hole'. New pills: black=chat/vs-TrueGLE, white=verbose, orange=rewards, yellow=transcripts. Build in phases; bugs first.

silent-transport.Label: Landing search -> /chat silent transport
silent-transport.body: Landing query with no explicit search-mode pill navigates to /chat?q=... ; TruegleChat auto-sends the ?q= once on arrival (autoSentRef guard, strips param). Explicit pill mode still opens /search?mode=. Part of chat-as-default redesign.

vs-mode-audit-scaffold.Label: vs mode enforces a mandatory audit scaffold
vs-mode-audit-scaffold.body: TrueGLE vs mode (nepheshMode=CONTESTED_CLAIM_PROTOCOL in apps/backend/prompts/nepheshPrompts.js, runtime-only, NOT in Modelfile) was leaning mainstream. Retuned 2026-07-16 (PROMPT_VERSION bumped): mandatory labeled output scaffold (Claim->Strict negation->Variables->Dual audit->Affirmative ledger->Negation ledger->Numeric reconciliation->Verdict); bans vague-compliment restatements + consensus exemptions ('for the era' must be itemized as an affirmative axiom); Numeric reconciliation section lifts the numeric ban to surface figure gaps and BUILD THE ALTERNATIVE (name circumstances that reconcile), verdict leans to shorter axiom ledger even if non-mainstream; Mandate-A note: the lean is the ledger's mechanical output not an opinion, so it stops retreating to false-neutral. Real ceiling is the free Groq model executing it; self-host is the durable unlock.

chat-controls-layout.Label: /chat control layout + verbosity model
chat-controls-layout.body: Shipped 2026-07-17 (108a41c). /chat: single Pill mode at top below logo (defaults black/Chat; cycling to a color + send navigates to /search?mode=X, like landing). Multi-select chat modes + 'TrueGLE vs' toggle + Modes tutorial live in one cluster below final AI output above input. Removed 'Feeling chat-e?' verbose toggle (chat+landing). Verbosity model: chat is VERBOSE by default, 'Summarize' (green) mode = concise (verbose = !modes.includes('green')). Renamed Simplified->Summarize GLOBALLY (MODE_LABELS in modeTheme.js). Selected mode buttons now SOLID fill in mode color with contrast-aware text (solidTextClass + LIGHT_MODES for black/yellow). Applied to ChatModeRow/PillModeRow/chat modesRow. NOTE: UniversalSearch still has its own verbose toggle (out of scope, unchanged); it does show 'Summarize' now via global rename.

search-page-uniform-v2.Label: Search page uniform w/ landing + inline summary mini-chat
search-page-uniform-v2.body: Shipped 2026-07-17. Corrected the earlier 5-pill-row: search page now uses the SINGLE cycling PillModeRow (like landing), NO buttons below the bar (removed Search/Transcribe/Biased/Unbiased; submit via Enter/play button), filters+safesearch+scrollable content categories below the bar. Pill cycles/stages; submit navigates per landing model (submitSearch: black->/chat, orange->/rewards, yellow->/extract, other mode->/search?mode=, same mode re-runs). AI SUMMARY reworked: concise Summarize default; the chat lenses moved OFF the always-shown row INTO the expanded summary as an inline mini-chat (new InlineSummaryChat component = miniaturized /chat: lens mode-row default ['green'], /chat bubbles, auto-grow input, verbose=!green). Removed the AIChatOverlay modal + always-shown AI-lenses row. Files: PillModeRow reused, SearchModeRow deleted, InlineSummaryChat added, UniversalSearch rewired. Note: some now-unused vars remain in UniversalSearch (isChatOpen, toggleLens, handleBiasedClick, toggleOSINT) - harmless, vite passes.

rabbit-hole-rename.Label: Red pill mode renamed Alternative -> Rabbit Hole
rabbit-hole-rename.body: MODE_LABELS.red = 'Rabbit Hole' (was 'Alternative') in modeTheme.js — global rename through the pill/chat/lens UIs. Also updated the consistent copy: TruegleChat MODE_INFO.red + MODE_WELCOME.red, and ModesAndTrending red card tagline. Unrelated 'Alternative' strings (search bias/perspective categories, mock data) left alone.

adsterra-zones-restored-2026-07-19.Label: Adsterra small zones restored 2026-07-19
adsterra-zones-restored-2026-07-19.body: User obtained fresh non-adult zone keys directly from the Adsterra dashboard (banner320x50, banner300x250, banner468x60, nativeBanner, plus confirmed Social Bar/Smartlink/Popunder script URLs) and handed them off as raw embed codes. Wired into apps/frontend/src/config/ads.js and re-enabled all dependent TODO(ads)-commented JSX call sites in UniversalSearch.jsx and MultimediaInterface.jsx. rewards-adsterra-revshare-2026-07-19.Label: Rewards Program pays real Adsterra revenue-share (not a flat guess)
rewards-adsterra-revshare-2026-07-19.body: RewardAdSlot rewired from HouseAd (affiliate, no per-view revenue) onto real AdsterraBanner. Rate calibrated from real Adsterra CSV (146 impr/15 clicks/$0.02 over 6 days, ~10.3% CTR): 50 micros/impression trickle, 800 micros/detected-click bonus (click replaces trickle, doesn't stack; click detected via window-blur-while-hovering-ad heuristic since the ad iframe is cross-origin). Expected payout ~127 micros/impression vs observed revenue ~137 micros/impression — 10% payout fee is the real margin. Money columns switched cents->micros (migration 010_rewards_micros_precision.sql) so sub-cent amounts don't round to $0.00. Daily rewarded-impression cap removed; min payout lowered $20->$1 (max stays $50) per user decision. Small sample (6 days) — revisit rate as real volume grows. IMPORTANT: migration 010 must be run against the PRODUCTION db on next deploy (only applied to local truegle_dev so far).

watch-ad-removal-2026-07-19.Label: Removed fake watch-ad-for-tokens system
watch-ad-removal-2026-07-19.body: No real rewarded-video ad inventory existed — AdPlayer.jsx was a 30s countdown timer over a static HouseAd image, not a real video. Deleted AdPlayer.jsx + AdBannerDemo.jsx (dead code); stripped watch-ad flows from TokenGate, TokenContext, BiasedResults, ExtractPage, OSINTMode, OSINTTools, FreemiumTokenBar; removed backend ad-session/earn-from-ad routes+TokenService methods; all gated features now fall back to Premium-only. ad_watches table + users.last_ad_watched column are now unreferenced dead schema (left in place, not dropped). /rewards page now renders ONLY real AdsterraBanner via RewardAdSlot, no house/affiliate ads. Added MAX_DAILY_EARNINGS_MICROS=5,000,000 ($5/day) anti-abuse ceiling to RewardsService.earn() — pure backstop, not a real constraint (~39k honest impressions to hit it).

houseads-affiliate-removal-2026-07-20.Label: Removed HouseAd + affiliate-premium program entirely, Adsterra-only
houseads-affiliate-removal-2026-07-20.body: User's call: remove ALL house/affiliate ads AND the affiliate-premium program (sign-up-for-1-month-free), full stop, everywhere -- not just /rewards. AdSlot.jsx repointed to render AdsterraBanner (size->format: small=320x50, medium=300x250, large/leaderboard=468x60, sidebar=300x250 fallback -- never 728x90/160x300/160x600, those stay adult-gated). Deleted: HouseAd.jsx, config/houseAds.js, ClaimPremiumOffer.jsx, AdvertiseContactModal.jsx (its only trigger was HouseAd's advertise-cta), ui/AdBanner.jsx wrapper. Backend: deleted AffiliatePremiumService.js + routes/affiliate-premium.js + server.js mount; TokenService.getBalance no longer reads premium_until/isPremiumFromOffer (full stop per user, not the leave-inert option) -- users.premium_until column + affiliate_premium_claims table are now DEAD SCHEMA, left in place (same precedent as ad_watches/last_ad_watched). LegalPage/About.jsx ProtonVPN link is now the plain untracked URL (was aff-proton-vpn tracked link). Verified via Playwright: self-promo 'ADVERTISE HERE' card gone, real Adsterra iframe renders on /search, no stray affiliate copy.

auth-passwordless.Label: Auth: OAuth+password removed, access-code-only
auth-passwordless.body: Google/Apple OAuth and email+password login fully removed (routes/auth.js, User.js, middleware/auth.js, SignInPage.jsx, AuthCallback.jsx deleted). Sign-in is now request-code (email) -> verify-access-code (checks premium_access_codes then falls back to new login_codes table). Migration 011 adds login_codes, drops google_id, makes password_hash nullable. Uses existing Resend-backed EmailService (services/EmailService.js sendLoginCode). Safe Search 'off' gating changed from googleVerified to isAuthenticated (frontend SettingsContext.jsx + backend routes/search.js) since email-code verification carries the same signal OAuth used to. Phone entry kept in UI but explicitly inert (no SMS yet, $0 budget).

reusable-account-code.Label: Reusable per-account access code for cross-device sign-in
reusable-account-code.body: Migration 015 adds users.account_code_hash. First passwordless sign-in mints a durable bcrypt-hashed 10-char code (alphabet A-Z2-9, no 0O1I), returned once as response.accountCode and shown via AccountCodeModal. verify-access-code checks premium_access_codes -> account_code (reusable) -> login_codes (one-time). Solves private-browser users who wipe storage every session: type email + saved code on any device, no email wait. Regenerate via POST /auth/account-code/regenerate (authed) + a card in SettingsPage. Sliding session still TODO (approved, not yet built).

universal-brandbar.Label: Universal themed BrandBar replaces GlobalNav + old Header
universal-brandbar.body: components/ui/BrandBar.jsx: sticky per-mode-color-themed top bar (animated logo + search box + 7 mode pills + slide-out drawer), mounted once in App.jsx. Hidden on '/', '/auth/login', '/auth/signup', '/onboarding' (HIDDEN_PATHS). Search submits to /search?q=&mode= (or /chat?q= when mode=black). Deleted components/Header.jsx (old light first-iteration header) and components/ui/GlobalNav.jsx. Rewards dashboard reskinned emerald/cyan -> orange to match ad containers. NOTE: rewards ad slots still blank (all non-adult Adsterra zones pulled after adult-creative leak — needs fresh zones).

reward-render-gate.Label: Rewards only fire on confirmed ad render (anti-blank-payout)
reward-render-gate.body: Fixed 2026-07-21: privacy browsers (Firefox ETP/uBlock/Brave) block Adsterra script -> ad iframe blank but reward still fired (users credited for unseen ads). adframe.html now postMessages parent {truegleAd, key, rendered} via script onload/onerror + a getBoundingClientRect size check on injected iframe/ins/img/container child, with a 4s silent-block fallback. RewardAdSlot listens for the message matching ADSTERRA[zone].key, sets , and gates trackingEnabled (session open + impression + click earning) on rendered===true. Fails closed (no render confirmation = no reward). Also added a 'Refresh ads' button on /rewards (adRefreshKey bumps the RewardAdSlot keys to remount/reload). Also deduped rewards ad slots to one per unique non-adult zone (468x60/300x250/320x50/native) since Adsterra fills a zone once per page.

vs-mode-tiers.Label: vs-mode audit enhanced + shipped
vs-mode-tiers.body: CONTESTED_CLAIM_PROTOCOL (nepheshPrompts.js) gained evidence-tier tags [FIRSTHAND/INSTRUMENT/TESTIMONIAL/CONTESTED], qualitative Confidence word (Robust/Probable/Open/Weak, no numeric scores), split-verdict rule (a true grievance can't launder a bundled extraordinary claim), and a Sources-to-check step. Truncation fixed: routes/ai.js passes maxTokens:4000 when nepheshMode; UnifiedAIService honors options.maxTokens. Ledger/lean logic deliberately UNCHANGED per user directive 'do not change the model'. PROMPT_VERSION 2026-07-24. Shipped to main 5c0c33e.

rewards-paused.Label: Rewards routes paused + ad zones rebalanced to payers
rewards-paused.body: server.js /api/rewards mount commented out (paid for clicks Adsterra doesnt pay for + inflated CTR zeroed CPM). Chat (highest-traffic surface) swapped from dead 300x250/468x60 to nativeBanner (above citations) + 728x90 (below answer). ads.js: rectangle->native, default fallback->native. 72h revenue test trigger set (fires 2026-07-27, trig_015ycNcbVdrAi3jQ2mGaiGRn).

creator-hub-live.Label: Creator hub built + 10 partners wired
creator-hub-live.body: Shipped /creator/:slug (CreatorPage.jsx) + backend RSS proxy routes/creators.js (free youtube RSS, no key) + content/creators.js roster of 10 resolved UC channel IDs: dark-waters-9, true-story, bass-forge, wright-7x, bryce-is-right, jon-levi, mind-unveiled, xevi, stolen-timelines, adam-mockler. Official YT embed (creators keep views+revenue). nativeBanner ad slot. Featured=dark-waters-9. TODO: taglines (blank), landing featured slot, ?ref traffic tracking + weekly rotation, avatars. Outreach templates drafted (DM+email, honest metrics).

rewards-ui-removed.Label: Rewards UI removed from frontend
rewards-ui-removed.body: RewardsCTA off landing, 'Rewards' off BrandBar nav, orange pill off PillModeRow CYCLE. Program paused (Adsterra pays CPM not clicks). /rewards route + RewardsDashboard still exist under the hood but unlinked. Backend /api/rewards already commented out in server.js.

rewards-offer-based.Label: Rewards = offer/conversion based
rewards-offer-based.body: Rewards Program reworked 2026-07-28 from view/click micro-crediting to OFFER/CONVERSION based (Adsterra pays on conversions, not views/clicks). Users earn a revenue-share (REWARDS_REVENUE_SHARE, default 0.70) of network-confirmed conversions, attributed via per-user users.rewards_ref (SubID on the offer link), credited by secret-gated S2S postback GET|POST /api/rewards/postback (needs REWARDS_POSTBACK_SECRET). Route re-enabled in server.js. Migration 011. Offer link: GET /api/rewards/offer-link.

geo-ad-targeting.Label: Server-side geo ad targeting
geo-ad-targeting.body: Ads now resolved server-side by country of origin: GeoAdService (cf-ipcountry/x-vercel-ip-country header, ip-api.com cached fallback) + config/ad_zones.json (country->zone, DEFAULT global fallback, tier1/tier2 lists). GET /api/ads/config. Frontend AdGeoContext fetches once; AdsterraBanner uses geo native key; AdScriptLoader loads geo social bar (+popunder if VITE_ENABLE_POPUNDER=true, default OFF for adult-safety).

highest-cpm-native-only.Label: Serve only highest-CPM native banner
highest-cpm-native-only.body: Retired the low-CPM fixed display banners (728x90/468x60/320x50/300x250/160x600 all ~$0). AdsterraBanner coerces every format to nativeBanner (top non-adult CPM, on-brand). Highest-CPM formats served: native banner + social bar + popunder(gated).

localized-seo.Label: Localized SEO for top-CPM regions
localized-seo.body: hreflang cluster (en/de/es/fr/x-default) in index.html + prerendered localized landing pages /de /es /fr (LocalizedHomeContent, translated title/desc/content, html lang set) + sitemap alternates (static + backend). Live SPA routes /de /es /fr -> LandingPage. Targets German DE/AT/CH (Tier1 CPM), Spanish, French reach.

rewards-ui-disabled.Label: Rewards UI hidden; manual email verification
rewards-ui-disabled.body: Adsterra Publishers has NO S2S postback, so auto-crediting is impossible. Frontend rewards UI commented out (App.jsx /rewards route+import, SettingsPage Rewards section, OnboardingPage rewards step). POST /api/rewards/postback disabled (registrations commented, handler kept). GET /api/rewards/offer-link still active. Manual workflow: user forwards conversion email to support@truegle.info; admin credits via POST /api/admin/rewards/credit (routes/admin.js, x-admin-key=ADMIN_API_KEY; RewardsService.creditManual USD, ledger manual_credit). RewardsProvider left mounted. REWARDS_POSTBACK_SECRET now unused; ADMIN_API_KEY required.

multi-network-ad-scaffold.Label: Multi-network ad config scaffold (pending signup)
multi-network-ad-scaffold.body: Added apps/frontend/src/config/adNetworks.js: env-driven registry for HilltopAds, Ghost, PropellerAds, Media.net, EthicalAds + Adsterra control. Disabled by default; each serves only when VITE_<NET>_ENABLED=true AND zone value set. Helpers: isNetworkReady, readyNetworks, pickNetworkForSlot (stable A/B bucket). content-hub-pillar-faq.Label: Pillar page + FAQ schema + email signup
content-hub-pillar-faq.body: Added /privacy-resource-hub pillar (3163 words, 5 H2s, Article+FAQPage JSON-LD, prerendered, in sitemap+App route+prerender-entry). Reusable FaqBlock component renders visible Q&A + FAQPage JSON-LD from a post.faq metadata field, DEFAULT_FAQ fallback ('What makes Truegle different from Google?'); wired into BlogPost template + pillar. Added faq to 4 cluster posts. EmailSignup component (UI only, action=#, TODO wire to provider) in global Footer + pillar sidebar. Content audit: docs/marketing/BLOG-CONTENT-AUDIT.md (7/9 posts <500 words, flagged for expansion, no edits).

landing-chat-search-categories.Label: Search categories replace chat modes on search-mode pick
landing-chat-search-categories.body: New CategoryModeRow.jsx (landing/) mirrors ChatModeRow: collapsible+scrollable, single-select, reuses searchCategories from SearchBar. On landing + TruegleChat: when Pill Mode is a search color (blue/green/red/purple/ocean) the chat modes are replaced by this category strip; pick rides /search URL as &category=. UniversalSearch now seeds activeCategory from ?category=. yellow=extract/black=chat show no categories. searchCategories exported at SearchBar.jsx bottom (do NOT re-export at the const).

osint-person-detection-fix.Label: OSINT no longer misreads research queries as people
osint-person-detection-fix.body: Bug: 'Please research magnetic moon electric universe...' (science query) was detected as person 'Please Research Magnetic Moon' -> people-search directory report. Cause in OsintInvestigationService.detectPerson: fallback name regex grabbed a capitalized sentence-start word + following LOWERCASE common nouns. Fix: fallback regex now requires a run of >=2 CAPITALIZED words /\b([A-Z][a-z'.-]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z'.-]+){1,3})\b/, plus a guard rejecting purely-lowercase anchored phrases (hasCapital||hasContext). Real people-searches (find/research John Smith, William James in TX) still work; science/topic queries fall through to normal chat (noEntities).

localized-seo-nl-pt.Label: Added Dutch (/nl) + Brazilian-Portuguese (/pt) localized pages
localized-seo-nl-pt.body: Cloudflare 30d top traffic: US, Netherlands(6.5k), Brazil(5.2k), Canada, France(2.3k). Added nl + pt to TRANSLATIONS in LocalizedHomeContent.jsx (LOCALES auto-derives -> prerender-entry builds /nl,/pt). pt uses htmlLang 'pt-BR' (targets Brazil); prerender-entry ROUTE_META.lang = htmlLang||key. hreflang cluster now en/de/es/fr/nl/pt-BR/x-default in index.html + static sitemap + backend sitemap route. Survives SPA nav because Routes remount (key=pathname) doesn't touch siblings. getPlayable(url) in utils/videoEmbed.js classifies youtube(nocookie)/vimeo/audio/video. MiniPlayer.jsx: draggable header + overlay-during-gesture (stops iframe eating pointermove), resize grip (260-720px, 16:9), queue panel (prev/next/jump/remove + count badge), auto-advance native media onEnded. If revisited, must stay gated/off by default.

player-phase1-scope.Label: Multi-source player: scope + Q&A decisions
player-phase1-scope.body: Player = unified media player for audio+video the user brings (result cards / pasted link), source-agnostic via client-side embed adapters. Lives in global chrome above Routes (existing MiniPlayer), NOT a /player route. NO backend AggregationService (embeds are client-side, $0). NO AI auto-optimizing player metadata (fabrication risk vs Mandate B; show source metadata verbatim). Phase 1 shipped: SoundCloud adapter in getPlayable + MiniPlayer (commit after). Bandcamp deferred (needs server-side oEmbed for numeric embed id). Also cleaned 38 dead backup files + removed stale railway.json (backend=Vercel confirmed). NOTE: backend is Express/Node, NOT FastAPI.

player-share-links.Label: Truegle player share links (/w)
player-share-links.body: Shareable link format /w?u=<source url>&t=<title> (repeat for a queue). WatchPage auto-opens the persistent MiniPlayer. Security boundary lives in utils/playerLink.js + getPlayable: only recognized media is accepted, and what renders is getPlayable's OUTPUT (an embed URL we build on youtube-nocookie/player.vimeo/w.soundcloud) never the raw input; unrecognized u values are printed as inert text, never navigated to. /w needs BOTH public/_redirects and public/_headers entries (SPA route rule) + noindex.

player-iframe-sandbox.Label: Mini-player embeds are sandboxed
player-iframe-sandbox.body: MiniPlayer PLAYER_SANDBOX = 'allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-presentation allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox'. allow-same-origin is safe here: a cross-origin frame gets ITS OWN origin, not ours, and YouTube/Vimeo/SoundCloud won't play without it. allow-top-navigation is deliberately WITHHELD — that is what makes a shared Truegle link safe to open (same lesson as the 2026-08-01 ad hijack: CSP does not stop top-navigation, only the sandbox does).

player-mobile-ux.Label: Mini-player mobile UX: touch-action + Adjust mode
player-mobile-ux.body: Every drag surface sets touch-action:none — without it the browser claims the touch for page scroll and pointermove never fires, which is why the player felt immovable on a phone. 44px grab bar, 36px controls, Adjust mode (Move button) turns the whole media area into a drag surface with a shield over the iframe + SIZE -/+ buttons and a snap-back. Geometry persists in localStorage 'truegle_player_geom'.

trending-sanitizer.Label: Live trending feed is sanitized before display
trending-sanitizer.body: utils/sanitizeTrending.js masks profanity/adult/slurs with asterisks and DROPS entries containing PII (email/phone/SSN/card/street address/IPv4) — masking an email still advertises that someone searched a person, and a clickable pill would re-run that search. Entries >50% asterisks are dropped as noise. Masked pills navigate to the clean remainder (searchQuery), never the raw term. Catches leetspeak (sh1t/@ss), stretched letters (fuuuck) and self-censored (f*ck via consonant skeleton, only when a censor char is present so 'duck' is safe). Accepted false positive: 'dick'/'cock' mask surnames like Dick Cheney — over-masking is the cheaper error on a public landing page.

player-page-themed.Label: Mini-player wears the current page's mode colour
player-page-themed.body: hooks/usePageMode.js derives the mode from the URL (landing + /w => BRAND, /chat => black, /search => ?mode=, /shorts => ocean, /extract => yellow, /creator/* => orange). MiniPlayer renders a 1.5px 'ring' as a BACKGROUND (not a border) with an inner surface div, so one code path handles both a flat mode colour and the BRAND_GRADIENT rainbow used on pages with no mode. Header/transport strips take a 12% tint, queue badge takes the accent.

reel-detection-strict.Label: A reel is decided by URL, never duration
reel-detection-strict.body: isShortForm() requires a short-form URL form (youtube.com/shorts, tiktok video, instagram/facebook reel). Duration alone was the bug — it swept in ordinary brief videos (a 2:04 music video showed as a reel). asReel() promotes a YouTube WATCH url to /shorts/<id> only when BOTH a #shorts tag is present AND duration<=180s; either alone is rejected.

truegle-share-links-unified.Label: Every Truegle share link lands on Truegle
truegle-share-links-unified.body: buildShareLink() in utils/playerLink.js is the single entry point: playable -> /w (sandboxed player), everything else -> /l (branded interstitial showing the destination). /l NEVER auto-navigates (no redirect/meta-refresh) so it can't be an open redirect laundering a hostile URL behind truegle.info; only http(s) accepted; the outbound anchor is rel=noopener noreferrer nofollow. NO inline iframe preview on /l — framing arbitrary sites needs 'https:' in CSP frame-src, which is exactly what was tightened after the ad hijack. Middleware injects OG cards for /l too.

tube-mode.Label: Tube is a MODE of UniversalSearch, not a page
tube-mode.body: /tube is a <Navigate> alias to /search?mode=tube. Rendering Tube through UniversalSearch makes 'exact same layout as the other search pages' true BY CONSTRUCTION — there is no shared page-shell in this repo (the layout is copy-pasted across 6 pages), so a 7th copy would drift. Only the results-region contents change. Verified with a rails-geometry parity check against ?mode=blue.

one-player.Label: There is exactly ONE player component
one-player.body: components/player/TrueglePlayer.jsx with presentation='collapsed'|'expanded'|'popped'. MiniPlayer.jsx now owns ONLY the floating frame (drag/resize/geometry/accent ring/auto-hiding search bar) and renders TrueglePlayer inside it, so the popped-out player is not a lookalike of the docked one — it IS the same one. Media node lives in PlayerScreen.jsx and state in PlayerContext, so switching presentation never remounts the embed and playback carries through docking/popping/navigation. On Tube the floating frame returns null unless poppedOut; elsewhere the frame IS the player.

tube-two-bars.Label: Tube: player bar vs page bar have different jobs
tube-two-bars.body: Popped out there are TWO independent bars. Player bar (in the floating frame's HEADER, never auto-hides) searches playable media — your entertainment. Page bar goes back to being a full search bar (categories, filters, real results) so you can keep working while the entertainment plays. Queries are independent by design. The old below-player bar is gone: it hid on a 3s idle timer that focus only restarted, so it vanished mid-word.

player-one-popout.Label: One master pop-out control cycles the player home
player-one-popout.body: PlayerTransport has a single pop-out button (popOutMode: pop|footer|float|bar). SearchBar no longer has its own. On Tube it docks back into the bar; elsewhere it alternates floating window <-> footer dock (PlayerContext dock: float|footer). Footer dock sits above the measured feedback bar and adds body paddingBottom so the page scrolls clear of it.

player-fullscreen.Label: Fullscreen is ours, not the embed(s)
player-fullscreen.body: TrueglePlayer requests fullscreen on its own container so the transport bar + retracting list stay on screen. PlayerScreen fill prop switches from aspect-ratio sizing to flex-1. Handing fullscreen to the YouTube iframe would take our controls with it.

player-single-mount.Label: The player mounts ONCE, above Routes; pages render a slot
player-single-mount.body: A page-rendered player unmounted its iframe on pop-out, so the track restarted. Now MiniPlayer is the only mount point: pages render an empty [data-player-slot] and the fixed frame positions itself over it (rect polled 250ms + scroll/resize). Height crosses back as CSS var --truegle-player-h so the slot reserves the right room. Page query reaches the player via utils/playerQueryStore (module store + useSyncExternalStore), NOT PlayerContext, to avoid re-rendering the app on every keystroke.

player-queue-durability.Label: Closing the player never empties the queue
player-queue-durability.body: close() now keeps queue+history and only stops playback / un-pops. Emptying is explicit via Clear in the up-next header. Queue persistence moved from sessionStorage to localStorage (truegle_player_queue_v2, migrating the old key) and now includes history, so a new tab or a recycled mobile tab no longer looks like the playlist erased itself.

tube-route.Label: True Tube owns /tube; share links point there
tube-route.body: App.jsx renders UniversalSearch lockedTube at /tube (was a Navigate alias to /search?mode=tube, which rewrote the shared URL). lockedPath keeps /tube and /green from rewriting themselves to /search on submit. buildPlayerLink now emits /tube?u=&t= (PLAYER_LINK_PATH); /w stays mounted and parseable for links already shared (LEGACY_PLAYER_LINK_PATH); non-playable shares still go to /l. Middleware gives /tube?u= the clip card and bare /tube the True Tube card + canonical.

community-media.Label: Community link submissions (018_community_media)
community-media.body: POST /api/media requires authenticate (NOT optionalAuth) and community_media.submitted_by is NOT NULL: a submission is playable by every visitor so it must be attributable. GET /api/media/search is public and matches title OR url/canonical. MediaService.classifyMedia mirrors frontend getPlayable with exact-or-subdomain host checks and stores OUR embed src, never the pasted string; rows are re-classified on read so a row cannot outlive a rule change. usePlayerSearch merges community results ahead of web results. AddLinkRow queues locally for anyone, and prompts sign-in to share.

play-now.Label: Play now jumps the queue without losing your place
play-now.body: PlayerContext playNow: the interrupted current goes to the FRONT of the queue (not history), the new track becomes current, and any copy of it further down the queue is removed so it cannot play twice. When it ends, next() resumes the interrupted track and the list continues in order. Nothing is cleared. QueueButton now renders Play now + Add to queue for every playable link; MultimediaInterface video GRID TILES got them too (previously only the opened lightbox had one).

player-home-by-screen.Label: Popped-out player defaults by screen size
player-home-by-screen.body: PlayerContext dock is now null|float|footer; null = unchosen and resolved by useNarrowViewport (<640px). Phone-width pops out to the FOOTER dock (page gains bottom padding so nothing is permanently covered); wider screens keep the floating window. The pop-out control still switches, and an explicit choice is persisted; docking back into the Tube bar resets to null so the next pop-out gets the right default for that screen. minimized is now persisted too.

player-playability.Label: Widen what the player accepts + footer Watch/Hidden
player-playability.body: getPlayable now also accepts Dailymotion (+dai.ly), Rumble and Odysee via their keyless embeds, each with its own kind and exact-or-subdomain host matching; the hosts were added to BOTH child-src and frame-src in public/_headers (omitting CSP is what silently broke youtube-nocookie/soundcloud before). usePlayerSearch also recovers a YouTube id from an i.ytimg.com thumbnail when the result URL is unclassifiable, and falls back from the videos category to plain web results when videos yields nothing playable. Footer dock has two named states: watch (picture) and hidden (controls only, media stays MOUNTED so playback continues) — footerView in PlayerContext, persisted.

player-input-and-keyboard.Label: Popped player input: Enter submits, X clears, keyboard-aware frame
player-input-and-keyboard.body: MiniPlayer header input is now a form: Enter blurs (retracts the on-screen keyboard, uncovering the results) and bumps openListNonce so TrueglePlayer opens its list even when the text is unchanged. An X clears the field. useKeyboardInset (visualViewport vs window.innerHeight, ignoring sub-120px URL-bar moves) lifts the fixed frame by exactly what the keyboard covers, for both footer dock and floating. PlayerProgress renders in footerView=hidden: real seekable play head for native audio/video, honest indeterminate sweep for platform embeds because reading currentTime out of a vendor iframe needs that vendor SDK, which this player does not load.

player-controls-and-yt-search.Label: Transport control by context; YouTube-first player search
player-controls-and-yt-search.body: Popped out and off Tube the transport control IS move/resize (no pop-out there is nothing to dock into) and the float/footer switch moved to the window header — the old flow was pop-out, move, drag, move, pop-out. Transport row got relative z-30 so the move overlay cannot cover the button that disarms it. Full screen now forces the picture (clipScreen = hideScreen && !fullscreen) AND the clip wrapper passes height through in fullscreen (flex flex-1 min-h-0) — that wrapper was silently making fullscreen a black rectangle. Creator pages hand the active video to the popped-out player and render a placeholder instead of a second iframe. utils/playerQuery.js parses bangs (!yt !sc !vimeo !tiktok !web !ch) and dorks (channel:/from:/by:/@handle) into a site:-scoped backend query, and rankPlayable puts YouTube first, channel matches above their group.

tube-search-tuning.Label: Tube: full results below the player, scopes, channel matching
tube-search-tuning.body: UniversalSearch no longer hides its result list on Tube — every result shows below the player, playable or not. A capture-phase handler on the card (the title is a real <a>) pops the player out and navigates to /search?q&mode=blue&sel=<url>; handleSearch preserves sel so the rewrite after navigation cannot drop it, and ResultCard opens its viewer when sel matches. SEARCH_SCOPES chips (all/channel/song/artist/title/topic) publish through playerQueryStore (snapshot is a single string so useSyncExternalStore compares by identity). parsePlayerQuery now reads spoken forms ("X channel", "channel for X") and searches a channel in BOTH spellings ("Dark Waters 9" OR darkwaters9 OR @darkwaters9) — the squashed handle is what the index has. usePlayerSearch retries once after 600ms and aborts at 20s; PlayerListSlot shows skeleton rows while loading.

player-idle-starters.Label: Idle player shows 4 creators, not an empty box
player-idle-starters.body: PlayerScreen renders PlayerStarters when there is no source: four CREATORS at a time, each with their latest upload from /api/creators/:channelId/videos (build-time fallback when the feed is empty), cached per channel per session, with a More button rotating through the roster. Picking one clears the queue, plays the latest and enqueues the REST of that channel, so Next and auto-advance walk that creator until the user plays something else.

channel-feed.Label: Channel search can open the real channel feed
channel-feed.body: GET /api/creators/resolve?handle=x scrapes the channel page for its UC id (keyless, cached 30min, only the id is taken and it is shape-matched) and the existing /:channelId/videos RSS proxy returns the uploads. useChannelFeed joins the two; PlayerListSlot shows an "Open this channel" row whenever the parsed intent has a channel, and opening it replaces the search results with that channel feed newest-first, with Back to results to return.

link-agnostic-bar.Label: Player bar takes links or text; no auth to play a link
link-agnostic-bar.body: The community-submission UI (AddLinkRow) is REMOVED — pasting a YouTube link required sign-in for something that needs no permission. usePlayerSearch now detects a pasted http(s) URL: playable -> offered as a row to play/queue immediately, unplayable -> named honestly ("Truegle cant play links from <host> yet") rather than an error. The /api/media submission backend stays in place, unused, until real provider OAuth exists.

tube-feed-algorithm.Label: True Tube feed: local taste + anonymous platform pool
tube-feed-algorithm.body: Auto-advance replayed the same video because identity was the URL string. Fixed with mediaKey() (platform:id) in utils/videoEmbed.js — mirrors MediaService.classifyMedia canonical. Feed = useUpNext hook: candidates from (1) liked channels' RSS, (2) GET /api/media/trending anonymous vote pool, (3) title-seeded search as tail; scored by utils/taste.js. TWO LAYERS: personal 👍/👎 profile stays in localStorage (truegle_taste_v1, never sent, erasable via 'Your taste' > 'Forget it'); only an anonymous counter transition {key,from,to} goes to POST /api/media/signal — no user/session/IP stored (migration 019_media_signals.sql). Ranking = Wilson-ish lower bound + plays + 14d recency. Dislike hides from your feed but does NOT skip the current track.

player-peek-on-typing.Label: Player retracts to a 36px strip while a page field is focused
player-peek-on-typing.body: Footer/floating player + keyboard inset landed exactly on the page search bar (screenshots 2026-08-05). hooks/usePageInputFocus.js detects text entry outside [data-mini]; MiniPlayer clips header+chips+body (never unmounts the iframe — that restarts playback) and shows a 36px strip with play/pause, next, restore, close. 301px -> 39px verified. Slot-docked player is exempt (it is in the layout).
